## Case studies

- [Navia](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/navia): rare disease intelligence platform aggregating nine medical sources. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Celery, Next.js.
- [The Proposal Maker](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/the-proposal-maker): reads an RFP or email thread with Claude and writes a branded proposal section by section.
- [FirstDeal](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/firstdeal): monitoring SaaS for the Dutch and German car market with Telegram and email alerts.
- [Hice.AI](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/hice-ai): multi tenant business platform where agents perform real operations.
- [JANUA Financial](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/janua-financial): OCR to fifty plus financial ratios and a formatted PDF report.
- [RotiShoti AI](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/rotishoti-ai): natural language food discovery for Pakistani cuisine.
- [Javea Denia Rentals](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/javea-denia-rentals): scooter and e-bike rental platform with live availability and Stripe.
- [Apple Music Metadata Validator](https://masabfarooque.com/portfolio/apple-music-validator): catches metadata errors before a music release is submitted.

## Experience

- Chord.fm, Full Stack Engineer, June 2026 to present. Browser based audio and
  video editor for podcasters and creators. Built the Music Library panel from
  scratch including waveform playback with click to seek. Backend in Go on AWS
  Lambda with DynamoDB, API Gateway and S3.
- Skylight Studio, Full Stack Engineer, March 2026 to present. Next.js internal
  tooling platform for the Engineering Solutions team, including The Proposal
  Maker built on the Claude API.
- Fixels.nl, Web Developer, November 2025 to April 2026. Shipped Javea Denia
  Rentals and FirstDeal.nl from empty repository to paying users.
- PentaByteX, Web Developer and SEO, September 2024 to February 2025. Led
  migrations from client side to server side rendering across client sites.
- Mindstorm Studios, Student Fellow, 2022 and 2023. Won Best Mechanics at the
  Rookie Game Jam 2022.

## Background

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, COMSATS University Islamabad, 2023.
Unity game developer from 2020 to 2023, with two published Android games past
ten thousand downloads. Founded ReplayJutsu, a gaming publication that reached
one hundred thousand monthly active users. Works solo, not as an agency: every
project is designed, built and deployed by him.

## Capabilities

Full stack product build, AI systems and agents, data pipelines and scraping,
SaaS platforms with billing and multi tenancy, interfaces with motion,
performance and technical SEO.

## Stack

TypeScript, Python, Go, SQL, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion,
FastAPI, Node.js, NestJS, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, Supabase, DynamoDB,
MongoDB, AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, Docker, Stripe, Claude API, OpenAI, Groq,
LangChain, retrieval augmented generation.
